test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The compound interest on ₹30,000 in 2 years at 7% rate of interest per annum compounded annually is:
solution:
**Given:**

P = Rs. 30,000

T = 2 years

R = 7%

**Formula used:**

CI = A - P

A = P(1 + R/100)T

A = Amount

P = Principle

CI = Compound Interest

R = Rate

T = Time in years

**Solution:**

CI = 30000(1 + 7/100)² - 30000

CI = 30000[1.07² - 1]

CI = 30000 x 0.1449

CI = Rs. 4,347

**Hence, the correct option is 1.**
